why: EGM behaviour can change under a passing suite when a dependency moves. These are the revisions every measurement in this repository was taken against. A run record cites them; the runbook checks them before a validation run against a real machine. libsas is re-pinned whenever its version increases.

libsas.howItIsHeld: QSP v2.3.5.32 declares libsas as FetchContent 'sas' at tag v5.4.5.11 and that declaration is not ours to edit. The M0 preset overrides it with FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_SAS, pointing the build at the checkout at C:/Progetti/libsas, which must be at this commit and clean.

qsp.howItIsHeld: The GIT_TAG of the qsp FetchContent declaration in QSP_DemoOpenGL/CMakeLists.txt, set there on the user's instruction and left uncommitted in that repository.

qpm2.howItIsHeld: QSP v2.3.5.32 fetches QPM2 v9.0.0.3, whose simulated acceptor never reports a ticket. Until QPM2 pull request 218 is released, the M0 preset overrides it with FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_QPM, pointing the build at the checkout at C:/Progetti/QPM2 on this branch.

qpmSimulator.howItIsHeld: SASWB_QPM_SIMULATOR_ROOT in the M0 preset points at the checkout at C:/Progetti/qpm_simulator, whose ticket encoder and wallet the substituted printer compiles in.

nvramArrangement.note: A machine master-resets memory not written in the arrangement it was built for. QSP v2.3.5.32 writes arrangement 13, measured on 2026-10-17. The committed fixtures are still arrangement 7 and cannot be restored onto it; a golden memory configured by hand in arrangement 13 is pending. The read-only checkout at C:/Progetti/QSP is arrangement 6 and must not be used as the build source.
